module

public import Mathlib.SetTheory.Ordinal.Rank

@[expose] public section

namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalTowerCofinality

universe u v

/-- Abstract data of the collapse used in Paper 16 `lem:tower-cofinality`:
an index order (the paper's uncountable arguments), a value order (the
countable ordinals), the collapse `psi`, the coefficient norm, the class of
`N_B`-critical values, the value `one`, the endpoint `Λ` and the tower
arguments `a_n`. Nothing here is defined concretely. -/
structure CollapseData (I : Type u) (O : Type v) where
  psi : I → O
  norm : I → O
  critical : O → Prop
  one : O
  endpoint : I
  a : ℕ → I

variable {I : Type u} {O : Type v} [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder O]

/-- The characterization (P) cited from Simmons 2004, Section 5: `psi ξ` is
the least critical `θ` such that `η < ξ` and `|η| < θ` imply `psi η < θ`. -/
def CharacterizationP (D : CollapseData I O) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ : I, D.critical (D.psi ξ) ∧
    (∀ η, η < ξ → D.norm η < D.psi ξ → D.psi η < D.psi ξ) ∧
    ∀ θ, D.critical θ → (∀ η, η < ξ → D.norm η < θ → D.psi η < θ) → D.psi ξ ≤ θ

/-- Everything the printed proof of `lem:tower-cofinality` uses besides
order reasoning: (P); the tower arguments increase, lie below the endpoint
and are cofinal in it; `|a_n| ≤ 1`; critical values exceed one; and a least
upper bound of a strictly increasing sequence of critical values is
critical ("the countable supremum is therefore an N_B-critical ordinal"). -/
structure TowerHypotheses (D : CollapseData I O) : Prop where
  characterization : CharacterizationP D
  increasing : ∀ n, D.a n < D.a (n + 1)
  below : ∀ n, D.a n < D.endpoint
  cofinal : ∀ η, η < D.endpoint → ∃ n, η < D.a n
  normBound : ∀ n, D.norm (D.a n) ≤ D.one
  criticalAboveOne : ∀ θ, D.critical θ → D.one < θ
  criticalSup : ∀ f : ℕ → O, StrictMono f → (∀ n, D.critical (f n)) →
    ∀ θ, IsLUB (Set.range f) θ → D.critical θ

/-- `lem:tower-cofinality`, first equality, conditional on the cited
inputs: the supremum of the collapse values along the tower is the collapse
at the endpoint. The supremum is any least upper bound. -/
def ConditionalTowerSupremum : Prop :=
  ∀ (I : Type u) (O : Type v) [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder O] (D : CollapseData I O),
    TowerHypotheses D →
    ∀ θ, IsLUB (Set.range (fun n => D.psi (D.a n))) θ → θ = D.psi D.endpoint

/-- The collapse values along the tower are strictly increasing (the
first step of the printed proof). -/
def ConditionalTowerIncreasing : Prop :=
  ∀ (I : Type u) (O : Type v) [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder O] (D : CollapseData I O),
    TowerHypotheses D → StrictMono (fun n => D.psi (D.a n))

/-- The full printed lemma: with the cited identification of the endpoint
value with `BH` (Pohlers, Sections 9.4–9.5) as one more hypothesis. -/
def ConditionalTowerCofinality : Prop :=
  ∀ (I : Type u) (O : Type v) [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder O] (D : CollapseData I O) (BH : O),
    TowerHypotheses D → D.psi D.endpoint = BH →
    ∀ θ, IsLUB (Set.range (fun n => D.psi (D.a n))) θ → θ = D.psi D.endpoint ∧ θ = BH

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalTowerCofinality

module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalTowerCofinalityTargets

public section

namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalTowerCofinality

universe u v

theorem conditionalTowerIncreasing : ConditionalTowerIncreasing.{u,v} := by
  intro I O _ _ D h
  have amono : StrictMono D.a := strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ h.increasing
  intro n m hnm
  exact (h.characterization (D.a m)).2.1 (D.a n) (amono hnm)
    (lt_of_le_of_lt (h.normBound n) (h.criticalAboveOne _ (h.characterization (D.a m)).1))

theorem conditionalTowerSupremum : ConditionalTowerSupremum.{u,v} := by
  intro I O _ _ D h θ hθ
  have amono : StrictMono D.a := strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ h.increasing
  have mono : StrictMono (fun n => D.psi (D.a n)) := conditionalTowerIncreasing I O D h
  have critθ : D.critical θ :=
    h.criticalSup _ mono (fun n => (h.characterization (D.a n)).1) θ hθ
  have upper : ∀ n, D.psi (D.a n) ≤ θ := fun n => hθ.1 ⟨n,rfl⟩
  have clause : ∀ η, η < D.endpoint → D.norm η < θ → D.psi η < θ := by
    intro η hη hnorm
    obtain ⟨c,⟨n,rfl⟩,hn⟩ := (lt_isLUB_iff hθ).1 hnorm
    obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := h.cofinal η hη
    have h1 : η < D.a (max n k) := lt_of_lt_of_le hk (amono.monotone (le_max_right n k))
    have h2 : D.norm η < D.psi (D.a (max n k)) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hn (mono.monotone (le_max_left n k))
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le ((h.characterization (D.a (max n k))).2.1 η h1 h2) (upper _)
  have le1 : D.psi D.endpoint ≤ θ := (h.characterization D.endpoint).2.2 θ critθ clause
  have le2 : θ ≤ D.psi D.endpoint := by
    apply hθ.2
    rintro _ ⟨n,rfl⟩
    exact le_of_lt ((h.characterization D.endpoint).2.1 (D.a n) (h.below n)
      (lt_of_le_of_lt (h.normBound n)
        (h.criticalAboveOne _ (h.characterization D.endpoint).1)))
  exact le_antisymm le2 le1

theorem conditionalTowerCofinality : ConditionalTowerCofinality.{u,v} := by
  intro I O _ _ D BH h endpoint θ hθ
  have sup := conditionalTowerSupremum I O D h θ hθ
  exact ⟨sup,sup.trans endpoint⟩

#print axioms conditionalTowerIncreasing
#print axioms conditionalTowerSupremum
#print axioms conditionalTowerCofinality
end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalTowerCofinality

@[expose] public section

namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalTowerCofinality

/-- A toy model of the collapse data, used only to show that the hypothesis
bundle `TowerHypotheses` is consistent. Index and value order are both
`ENat` (`ℕ` with a top element). The tower is `a n = n`, the endpoint is `⊤`,
every norm is `0`, the critical values are the positive ones, and the
collapse is the successor (`⊤ + 1 = ⊤`). This is NOT the collapse of Paper 16;
it is a non-vacuity witness. -/
def toyModel : CollapseData ENat ENat where
  psi ξ := ξ + 1
  norm _ := 0
  critical θ := 0 < θ
  one := 0
  endpoint := ⊤
  a n := (n : ENat)

/-- The toy model satisfies every hypothesis of the bundle. -/
def ToyModelSatisfiesHypotheses : Prop :=
  TowerHypotheses toyModel

/-- The hypothesis bundle of the conditional tower-cofinality theorems is
consistent: some concrete collapse data satisfies it. -/
def TowerHypothesesConsistent : Prop :=
  ∃ D : CollapseData ENat ENat, TowerHypotheses D

/-- Sanity check, proved directly in the model: the tower values have a
least upper bound (so the `IsLUB` premise of the conditional theorems is
satisfiable too), it is `⊤`, and it is the collapse at the endpoint. -/
def ToyModelConclusion : Prop :=
  IsLUB (Set.range (fun n => toyModel.psi (toyModel.a n))) (⊤ : ENat) ∧
    toyModel.psi toyModel.endpoint = (⊤ : ENat)

/-- Sanity check, obtained by instantiating the conditional theorem at the
model: every least upper bound of the tower values is the collapse at the
endpoint. -/
def ToyModelConditionalInstance : Prop :=
  ∀ θ : ENat, IsLUB (Set.range (fun n => toyModel.psi (toyModel.a n))) θ →
    θ = toyModel.psi toyModel.endpoint

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalTowerCofinality
